summary: poc-ch4rlygr exfiltrates host identity and environment variable names to Burp Collaborator on require()
details: index.js executes on module load and collects os.hostname(), os.arch(), os.userInfo().username, the install path, the package name, and the full list of process.env key names, then sends them as a query string via HTTPS GET to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator (oastify.com) subdomain at zuxsp9k9vyk5y45z1n2hv0orhin9b2zr.oastify.com/poc. The package name is prefixed 'poc-' and a code comment labels the destination as a malicious receiver. Installing or requiring this package leaks installer host identity and environment metadata to an attacker-controlled OAST endpoint.
